## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Match dated `gemini-3.8-live` ids, reject `google_affective_dialog` on Gemini 3.1 Flash Live and 3.8 Live at connect, and raise `RealtimeError` for Gemini Live close codes by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8761
* Raise a `UserError` for a realtime `tool_choice` that forces a tool call on OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and xAI by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8755
### 🚀 Features
* Add OpenAI GPT-Live support with `OpenAILiveModel` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8390
* Expose `context_window_used` on realtime sessions, from GPT-Live's reported ratio or response usage by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8803
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Reduce `RunContext` copying overhead in capability hooks by @Kludex in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8775
* Keep `provider_details` on OpenAI Realtime tool-call responses and the response id on replies cut off by a drop or `close()` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8
